entities.summary: Enrico Bovone was an Italian basketball player. He was part of the Italian team that finished eighth at 1968 Summer Olympics. Bovone was married twice and both time divorced; he had five children from one of those marriages. He committed suicide on 2 May 2001, aged 55.
